entities.name: Ittono Khairt ni Hata Kan
entities.description: A wrestler from Oneah who became a knight in Amjad.

entities.name: Oneah
entities.description: Land on Dominaria where Khairt was raised.

entities.name: Telina Hata
entities.description: Master of the wrestling school Khairt trained at.

entities.name: Istini Ayesh ni Hata Kan
entities.description: Fellow wrestler who survived the Fall of Oneah, believing herself the sole survivor.

entities.name: Fall of Oneah
entities.description: Goblin attack in 4165 AR in which Khairt's companions were slain.

entities.name: Xa-On
entities.description: Where Khairt faced the goblin hordes.

entities.name: Amjad
entities.description: Land where Khairt became a knight.

entities.name: Heart of Shanodin
entities.description: Magical forest that reveals each person's true self.

entities.name: Shanodin dryad
entities.description: Dryad Khairt fell in love with.

events.summary: Khairt's wrestling career ends after body blows to both knees.
events.quote: a second body blow to his other knee ended his career

events.summary: In the Fall of Oneah, Khairt and his colleagues face the goblin hordes in Xa-On; he is knocked unconscious and survives alone, as does Ayesh.
events.quote: both Khairt and Ayesh survived, each thinking themself the sole survivor

events.summary: Khairt becomes a knight in Amjad and is partnered with the assassin Daisilodavi, whom he hates.
events.quote: he found employment as a knight working for the land's eponymous king

events.summary: The king sends Khairt and Daisilodavi to the Heart of Shanodin to murder Lord Glinham.
Khairt falls in love with a dryad; Daisilodavi breaks the spell by murdering her.
events.quote: broke the spell on Khairt by murdering the dryad

events.summary: Daisilodavi confesses feelings for Khairt, who finds he returns them; they ride back to Amjad together.
events.quote: with a new bond forged between them

relations.quote: he trained as a wrestler under master Telina Hata
working for the land's eponymous king
Daisilodavi then professed to Khairt that he felt something more for the knight than animosity.
